name: Modbus TCP
description: Read and write Modbus TCP registers on PLCs, gateways and remote IO couplers. Connects to the host and port you enter (502 by default).

contributions.label: Modbus TCP
contributions.description: Create an empty Modbus workspace; devices, addresses and timing are configured inside the workbench.

fields.label: Workspace name
fields.description: Only labels the workspace. The host, port and slave id belong to each device inside the workbench.

contributions.label: Modbus TCP workbench
contributions.description: Register table with periodic polling and inline writes; devices are configured and connected inside the workbench.

recommendations.label: Explain this register table
recommendations.prompt: Explain what each entry in the current Modbus register table represents and point out overlapping or unreadable address ranges.

recommendations.label: Diagnose failing addresses
recommendations.prompt: Use the errors shown in the workbench to explain which Modbus addresses failed and the most likely cause (illegal address, data type or byte order).

contributions.description: Read-only Modbus TCP tools for the DBX AI assistant.

zh-CN.name: Modbus TCP
zh-CN.description: 读写 PLC、网关与远程 IO 上的 Modbus TCP 寄存器，主动连接你填写的 host:port（默认 502）。

io.github.yuzhi.modbus.modbus.label: Modbus TCP

display_name.description: 只用于标识这个工作区。主机地址、端口和从站号属于工作台里的每台设备。
